title: Alaska Shore Excursions

services.name: Mountain Point Snorkeling
services.desc: Looking for an up-close view of Ketchikan's rich assortment of marine life? Only 5 miles from town, our premier snorkeling destination awaits, featuring shallow tide pools teeming with marine life and steep underwater rock walls for freediving. An expert team is ready to outfit you with top-of-the-line gear to safely and comfortably snorkel Alaska's beautifully pristine ocean. From delicate sea stars to forests of bull kelp, there is something to see beyond every rock. You might even catch a glimpse of Ketchikan's "Salmon Capital of the World" namesake. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Our captains and naturalists will take you in search of humpback and killer whales, sea lions, porpoises and so much more! A multi-year award winner as one of the best excursions in North America, your Juneau whale watching journey will take you through Favorite Channel, Stephens Passage, Lynn Canal, or Saginaw Channel, all popular spots for spotting some of Southeast Alaska's finest wildlife. Take a guided bus ride from downtown Juneau out to Auke Bay, where you will board one of our specially designed boats with large windows, heated cabins, and outdoor decks. Come aboard for up-close viewing of Alaska's most incredible creatures, while listening to a naturalist and experienced guide.

services.name: Bike (3)
services.desc: On new peddle assist, electric bikes, your guide will lead you on a 10 mile (roundtrip) ride along the coastline to where the road ends at the edge of the extensive wilderness. This route is a shared highway but with minimal traffic. At the Tongass National Rainforest, you will take a guided hike through dense rainforest, across a stream to a beautiful waterfall and the late season salmon run. This 1.25 mile educational hike features a wide array of flora, fauna, and beautiful beach views from which you may spot seals swimming, salmon jumping, humpback whales feeding near the shoreline or orcas passing by. services.name: Kayak (5)
services.desc: Prepare to come face to face with the magnificent Mendenhall Glacier on this ultimate Alaskan adventure. Traveling with a small group in a canoe, your guide will help you navigate past icebergs, waterfalls, and steep cliffs once carved by ice. You will help paddle the canoe as close as possible on the expedition toward the face of the Glacier. This small, intimate adventure begins by meeting your professional guide at Mt.Robert's Tramway building. You will enjoy a narrated scenic drive to a more remote part of the Tongass National Forest, where you will first lay eyes on the ever-changing Mendenhall Glacier. services.name: Fishing (7)
services.desc: The best fish you’ll ever eat in Alaska is the one you catch yourself! Embark on an authentic fishing adventure in the pristine wilderness along Alaska’s coastline. You’ll be outfitted with waterproof boots, bib overalls, a hooded jacket, hat, and gloves to ensure you're comfortable as you set off in a stable, open-air 24-foot skiff. Glide through awe-inspiring scenery while you cast your line-what you catch will become the centerpiece of a gourmet meal at a remote campsite! With just six guests per boat, your professional guide will tailor the experience to match your interests and skill level.
